mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, tenant_id, kb_id, version, chunk_count, operator_id, change_type, change_remark, collection_name, current_active, create_time FROM doc_version WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, doc_id, tenant_id, kb_id, version, chunk_count, operator_id, change_type, change_remark, collection_name, current_active, create_time FROM doc_version WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND current_active = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, doc_id, tenant_id, kb_id, version, chunk_count, operator_id, change_type, change_remark, collection_name, current_active, create_time FROM doc_version WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND version = #{version}

SELECT id, doc_id, tenant_id, kb_id, version, chunk_count, operator_id, change_type, change_remark, collection_name, current_active, create_time FROM doc_version WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doc_version (doc_id, tenant_id, kb_id, version, chunk_count, operator_id, change_type, change_remark, collection_name, current_active, create_time) VALUES (#{docId}, #{tenantId}, #{kbId}, #{version}, #{chunkCount}, #{operatorId}, #{changeType}, #{changeRemark}, #{collectionName}, #{currentActive}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE doc_version SET current_active = 0 WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
UPDATE doc_version SET current_active = 1 WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND version = #{version}
